rationale: Whole-face zero-shot is a useful harsh diagnostic but not a realistic first-language curriculum. This factorial split ensures every face and every relation appears in training while withholding their particular pairing, testing factorization rather than never-seen-script recognition.
evaluation_rule: For each fold, remove all teaching surfaces for the four held-out relation-face pairs, retain all other relation-face teaching surfaces, and classify the held-out surface for each removed pair.
stronger_candidate_must: beat the prefrozen surface-only factorial baseline
reconstruct teacher theater targets without receiving relation_id at evaluation
show ablations for participant/KFS indexing and temporal order
retain face-specific residuals instead of forcing translation equivalence
WITHHOLD rather than fabricate unsupported structure
claim_fence: Factorial baseline only. It is not evidence of language competence, cultural cognition, semantic ownership, or internalization.
